answer: Proof-of-Stake protocols mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring agents to harbor significant capital to validate transactions. This economic barrier prevents the creation of a massive, cheap echo of identities, as each additional node requires a proportional investment. Unlike a fable of infinite free resources, the cost to an attacker scales linearly with network influence, forcing them to commit tangible assets rather than spinning up ephemeral, zero-cost digital identities.
